```{r SETUP}
#| include: false
intro_date = format(as.Date(params$dates$intro), "%B %e, %Y")

has_adopt_date = !is.null(params$dates$adopt)
adopt_date = format(as.Date(params$dates$adopt), "%B %e, %Y")

has_assent_date = !is.null(params$dates$assent)
assent_date = format(as.Date(params$dates$assent), "%B %e, %Y")

has_effective_date = !is.null(params$dates$effective)
effective_date = format(as.Date(params$dates$effective), "%B %e, %Y")
is_effective = as.Date(params$dates$effective) <= as.Date(lubridate::today())
```

::: {.history-intro}
<!--Introduced by {{< meta params.sponsor >}} on {{< meta params.intro_date >}}.-->
```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cat(paste0("Introduced by ", params$sponsor, " on ", intro_date, "."))
```
:::

::: {.history-post}
```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
if (has_adopt_date) { cat(paste0("Adopted by the Council of State on ", adopt_date, ".")) }
```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
if (has_assent_date) { cat(paste0("Granted royal assent and enacted on ", assent_date, ".")) }
```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
if (has_adopt_date) {
    if (has_assent_date) {
        if (has_effective_date) {
            if (is_effective) {
                cat(paste0("Entered into effect on ", effective_date, "."))
            } else {
                cat(paste0("_Scheduled to enter into effect on ", effective_date, "._"))
            }
        } else {
            if (as.Date(params$assent_date) <= as.Date(lubridate::today())) {
                cat("Entered into effect immediately upon enactment.")
            } else {
                cat("_Scheduled to enter into effect immediately upon enactment._")
            }
        }
    }
}
```
:::
